title: ```yaml agentive-review-rules``` block in the review criteria file (code_review.md, the single criteria file; U4=C)
description: Rules data for RV2 (trust boundary and confirm_scope), RV3 (deterministic classification) and RV4 (tier). Read by scripts from the base commit (git show $BASE_SHA:code_review.md), never from the PR branch, and never by LLM reviewers.

confirm_scope_globs.description: RV2.confirm_scope (U2.non_interactive, user decision 2026-10-14): one glob list per U2 confirm_scope category (review_config added 2026-10-15 with the U6 customization). A changed path that matches, made without a human confirmation, is delivered as a PR only and RV4 forces tier 2. The project may add globs (for example generated hook scripts); every category keeps at least one glob, so the check cannot be emptied.

never_ai_approve.description: the managed list: the shipped floor, the stack presets (source preset:<id>) and the CODEOWNERS snapshot (source codeowners:<line>) that /agentive:init and /agentive:update write (SECPATHS). Matching is case-sensitive; a glob also matches a directory and everything below it; a token matches one path segment token (split at _ - . and spaces), so `auth` never matches `author`.

extend_defaults.description: true (default): the framework floor (review/config.py DEFAULT_RULES) is merged with this block, so an improved floor reaches a repo that already has the block (gitleaks `useDefault` precedent). false: only this block counts; confirm_scope keeps at least one glob per category either way.

add.description: the project's own additions: a path glob, a path token, or a content rule {path, contains}. Merged into never_ai_approve / content_rules; a learned rule from /distill starts with shadow: true.

remove.description: entries of the floor or the managed list the project does not treat as security sensitive. The reason is required and appears in the review report; the change is a human-merged PR (code_review.md is protected_check_config).

content_rules.description: L3: {path, contains} rules evaluated on the added and removed lines of the changed files (plain substring, case-sensitive). Written by init/update for the detected stack presets (source preset:<id>).

protected_check_config.description: extra paths the project adds to the protected check-config list (reason check_config). The framework list (.agents/** except .agents/state/**, .claude/**, .codex/**, code_review.md, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md managed regions, reviewer eval cases evals/reviewer/**, lint/typecheck/format config files from the agentive manifest evidence.files) is built in and cannot be removed or disabled

confirm_scope_without_human_tier.description: RV4.u2_non_interactive: a confirm_scope hit without human confirmation is tier 2. Fixed by the user decision U2.non_interactive; not tunable.

tier0_classes.description: default docs and format (conservative); a project may add lockfile or generated, never another class

tier0_class.description: classes that may be tier 0: only mechanically verifiable changes decided by rules (2026-10-27)

source.description: where the entry came from: codeowners:<line> (L1 snapshot), preset:<id> (L3 stack preset), add (the project)

shadow.description: report only: the hit is listed in rv2.shadow_hits and forces no tier; a human removes it after it proved itself (SECPATHS learning)
